title: AI pricing and contract scn analysis
purpose: Compares subscription, per-use, risk-sharing, and hybrid pricing arrangements under different volume, uptake, performance, and savings assumptions.
input: `Scenarios` sheet with contract scenario, fixed fee, per-use fee, eligible volume, adoption rate, expected benefit per use, realization probability, implementation cost, and performance payment; `Parameters` sheet with time horizon.
outputs: Scenario cost, realized benefit, net benefit, ROI, cost per active use, ranked comparison, and contract-scenario visualization.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
